G0243.def:
**ἄλλος**, -η, -ο, (cf. Lat. alius, Eng. **else**),
[in LXX for אַחֵר ,אֶחָד, etc. ;]
**other, another**: absol., [[Mat.20.3|Mat.20:3]], al.; ἄ. δέ, [[1Co.3.10; 12.8|1Co.3:10 12:8]]; pl., [[Mrk.6.15|Mrk.6:15]] attached to a noun, [[Mat.2.12; 4.21|Mat.2:12 4:21]], al.; with art., ὁ ἄ., **the other**, [[Mat.5.39|Mat.5:39]], [[Jhn.19.32|Jhn.19:32]] (Bl., §47, 8); οἱ ἄ., **the others, the rest**, [[Jhn.20.25|Jhn.20:25]], [[1Co.14.29|1Co.14:29]]; ἄ. πρὸς ἄλλον = πρὸς ἀλλήλους (BL, §48, 10), [[Act.2.12|Act.2:12]] ἄλλ᾽ (i.e. ἄλλο) ἤ (Bl., §77, 13), [[Luk.12.51|Luk.12:51]] before πλήν, [[Mrk.12.32|Mrk.12:32]] εἰ μή, [[Jhn.6.22|Jhn.6:22]] παρά with accusative, [[1Co.3.11|1Co.3:11]]
_SYN._: ἕτερος, which see ἄ. denotes numerical, ἕ. qualitative difference (Cremer, 89). ἄ. generally "denotes simply distinction of individuals, ἕ. involves the secondary idea of difference in kind" (see Lft., Meyer, Ramsay, on [[Gal.1.6|Gal.1:6]], 7; Tr., _Syn._, §xcv; BL, §51, 6; M, _Pr._, 79f., 246; MM, _VGT_, s.vv.). As to whether the distinction can be maintained in [[1Co.12.8, 10|1Co.12:8, 10]] see _ICC_, in l., and on [[Heb.11.35|Heb.11:35]]f., see Westc, in l. (AS)

G0200.def:
**ἀκρίς**, -ίδος, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for אַרְבֶּה, also for חָגָב, etc. ;]
**a locust**: [[Mat.3.4|Mat.3:4]], [[Mrk.1.6|Mrk.1:6]], [[Rev.9.3|Rev.9:3]], 7.†
(AS)

G0257.def:
**ἅλων**, -ωνος
(for Attic ἅλως, -ω, see MM, _VGT_, see word), ἡ, [in LXX chiefly for גֹּרֶן ;]
**a threshing floor**: [[Mat.3.12|Mat.3:12]], [[Luk.3.17|Luk.3:17]] (here prob. by meton. = the grain on the threshing floor).†
(AS)

G0235.def:
**ἀλλά** (ἀλλ᾽ usually bef. α and υ, often bef. ε and η, rarely bef. ο and ω, never bef. ι; Tdf., _Pr._, 93 f.; WH, _App._, 146),
_adversative particle_,
**stronger than δέ**; prop. neuter pl. of ἄλλος, used adverbially, with changed accent; hence prop. **otherwise, on the other hand** (cf. [[Rom.3.31|Rom.3:31]]);
1. opposing a previous negation, **but**: οὐ (μὴ) . . . ἀ., [[Mat.5.15, 17|Mat.5:15, 17]] [[Mrk.5.39|Mrk.5:39]], [[Jhn.7.16|Jhn.7:16]], al.; rhetorically subordinating but not entirely negativing what precedes, οὐ . . . ἀ., **not so much . . . as**, [[Mrk.9.37|Mrk.9:37]], [[Mat.10.20|Mat.10:20]], [[Jhn.12.44|Jhn.12:44]], al.; with ellipse of the negation, [[Mat.11.7-9|Mat.11:7-9]], [[Act.19.2|Act.19:2]], [[1Co.3.6; 6.11; 7.7|1Co.3:6 6:11 7:7]], [[2Co.7.1|2Co.7:1]], [[Gal.2.3|Gal.2:3]], al.; in opposition to a foregoing pos. sentence, ἀ. οὐ, [[Mat.24.6|Mat.24:6]], [[1Co.10.23|1Co.10:23]]; οὐ μόνον . . . ἀ. καί, [[Jhn.5.18|Jhn.5:18]], [[Rom.1.32|Rom.1:32]], al.; elliptically, after a negation, ἀ. ἵνα, [[Mrk.14.49|Mrk.14:49]], [[Jhn.1.8; 9.3|Jhn.1:8 9:3]], al.; = εἰ μή (Bl., §77, 13; M, _Pr._, 241; but cf. WM, §iii, 10), [[Mat.20.23|Mat.20:23]], [[Mrk.4.22|Mrk.4:22]].
2. Without previous negation, to express opposition, interruption, transition, etc., **but**: [[Jhn.16.20; 12.27|Jhn.16:20 12:27]], [[Gal.2.14|Gal.2:14]]; before commands or requests, [[Act.10.20; 26.16|Act.10:20 26:16]], [[Mat.9.18|Mat.9:18]], [[Mrk.9.22|Mrk.9:22]], al.; to introduce an accessory idea, [[2Co.7.11|2Co.7:11]] in the apodosis after a condition or concession with εἰ, ἐάν, εἴπερ, **yet, still, at least**, [[Mrk.14.29|Mrk.14:29]], [[1Co.9.2|1Co.9:2]], [[2Co.4.16|2Co.4:16]], [[Col.2.5|Col.2:5]], al.; after μέν, [[Act.4.17|Act.4:17]], [[Rom.14.20|Rom.14:20]], [[1Co.14.17|1Co.14:17]]; giving emphasis to the following clause, ἀλλ᾽ ἔρχεται ὥρα, **yea**, etc., [[Jhn.16.2|Jhn.16:2]] so with neg., ἀλλ᾽ οὐδέ, **nay, nor yet**, [[Luk.23.15|Luk.23:15]]
3. Joined with other particles (a practice which increases in late writers; Simcox, _LNT_, 166), ἀ. γε, **yet at least**, [[Luk.24.21|Luk.24:21]], [[1Co.9.2|1Co.9:2]]; ἄ ἤ., **save only, except**, [[Luk.12.51|Luk.12:51]], [[2Co.1.13|2Co.1:13]]; ἀ. μὲν οὖν, [[Php.3.8|Php.3:8]] (on this usage, see MM, _VGT_, see word).
(AS)

G0293.def:
**ἀμφίβληστρον**, -ου, τό
(ἀμφιβάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for חֵרֶם ;]
something thrown around, as **a garment**; spec., **a casting-net**: [[Mat.4.18|Mat.4:18]]†
(AS)

G0231.def:
**ἁλεεύς** (Rec. ἁλιεύς, the older form; WH, _App._, 151, -έως, ὁ
(ἅλς, **the sea**) [in LXX for דָּג, דַּוָּג ;]
**a fisherman**: [[Mat.4.18, 19|Mat.4:18, 19]], [[Mrk.1.16, 17|Mrk.1:16, 17]], [[Luk.5.2|Luk.5:2]]
(AS)

G0217.def:
**ἅλας** (T, ἅλα), -ατος, τό, late form of cl. ἅλς, -ος, ὁ (MM, _VGT_, see word),
[in LXX chiefly for מְלַח ;]
**salt**, lit, and figuratively: [[Mat.5.13|Mat.5:13]], [[Mrk.9.50|Mrk.9:50]] [[Luk.14.34|Luk.14:34]]; like cl. ἅλες, **wit**, of wisdom and grace in speech: [[Col.4.6|Col.4:6]]†
(AS)

G0233.def:
**ἁλίζω**
(ἅλς), [in LXX for מָלַח ;]
**to salt, season with salt**: [[Mat.5.13|Mat.5:13]], [[Mrk.9.49|Mrk.9:49]].†
(AS)

G0281.def:
**ἀμήν**, indecl. (Heb. אָמֵן, verbal adj. fr. אמן, **to prop.** ni., **be firm**),
[in LXX: [[1Ch.16.36|1Ch.16:36]], I [[Est.9.46|Est.9:46]], [[Neh.5.13; 8.6|Neh.5:13 8:6]], [[Tob.8.8; 14.15|Tob.8:8 14:15]], [[3Ma.7.23|3Ma.7:23]], [[4Ma.18.24|4Ma.18:24]] (elsewhere ''א is rendered ἀληθινός, [[Isa.65.16|Isa.65:16]] ἀληθῶς, [[Jer.28.6|Je 35 (28):6]]; γένοιτο, [[Num.5.22|Num.5:22]], [[Deu.27.15|Deu.27:15]]ff., [[1Ki.1.36|3Ki.1:36]], Psa.40 (41):13 71 (72):19 105 (106):48, [[Jer.11.5|Jer.11:5]])*.]
1. As _adj._ (cf. Is, l.with), ὁ ἀ., [[Rev.3.14|Rev.3:14]]
2. As _adv._,
(a) **in solemn assent to the statements or prayers of another **(Nu, Ne, etc., ll. with): ὁ ἀ., [[1Co.14.16|1Co.14:16]]
(b) **similarly, at the end of one's own prayer or ascription of praise**: [[Rom.1.25; 15.33|Rom.1:25 15:33]], [[Gal.1.5|Gal.1:5]], [[1Ti.1.17|1Ti.1:17]];
(with) in the Gospels, exclusively, introducing solemn statements of our Lord, **truly, verily**: [[Mat.5.18, 26|Mat.5:18, 26]] [[Mrk.3.28|Mrk.3:28]] (see Swete, in l.), [[Luk.4.24|Luk.4:24]], al.; ἀ. ἀ., always in [[Jhn.1.52; 3.3; 5.19|Jhn.1:52 3:3 5:19]], al.; τὸ ναί, καὶ . . . τὸ ἀ., [[2Co.1.20|2Co.1:20]] (on usage in π., see MM, _VGT_, see word).
(AS)

G0218.def:
**ἀλείφω**
(cf. λίπος, oil), [in LXX: [[Gen.31.13|Gen.31:13]], [[Exo.40.15|Exo.40:15]], [[Num.3.3|Num.3:3]] (מָשַׁח), [[Ezk.13.10|Eze.13:10]] ff. (טוּחַ), [[Rut.3.3|Rut.3:3]], [[2Sa.12.20; 14.2|2Ki.12:20 14:2]], [[2Ki.4.2|4Ki.4:2]], [[2Ch.28.15|2Ch.28:15]], [[Mic.6.15|Mic.6:15]], Dan LXX TH [[Dan.10.3|Dan.10:3]] (סוּךְ), [[Est.2.12|Est.2:12]], [[Jdt.16.8|Jdth.16:8]] * ;]
**to anoint, festally or in homage**: with accusative of thing(s) or of person(s), [[Mat.6.17|Mat.6:17]], [[Jhn.12.3|Jhn.12:3]], [[Mrk.16.1|Mrk.16:1]]; before dative, ἐλαίῳ, [[Mrk.6.13|Mrk.6:13]], [[Jas.5.14|Jas.5:14]]; μύρῳ, [[Luk.7.38, 46|Luk.7:38, 46]], [[Jhn.11.2|Jhn.11:2]].†
_SYN._: χρίω, μυρίζω (against the distinction made bet. ἀ. and χ. in Tr., _Syn._, § 38, see MM, _VGT_, see word, ἀ.) (AS)

G0285.def:
**ἄμμος**, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for חוֹל ;]
**sand, sandy ground**: [[Mat.7.26|Mat.7:26]], [[Rom.9.27|Rom.9:27]], [[Heb.11.12|Heb.11:12]], [[Rev.18.1|Rev.18:1]], [[Rev.20.8|Rev.20:8]].†
(AS)

G0258.def:
**ἀλώπηξ**, -εκος, ἡ
[in LXX for שׁוּעָל ;]
**a fox**: [[Mat.8.20|Mat.8:20]], [[Luk.9.58|Luk.9:58]]; metaphorically, of Herod, [[Luk.13.32|Luk.13:32]]†
(AS)

G0268.def:
**ἁμαρτωλός**, -όν
(ἁμαρτάνω), [in LXX chiefly for רָשָׁע ;]
**sinful, a sinner**: of all men, [[1Ti.1.15|1Ti.1:15]] of those especially wicked, [[1Ti.1.9|1Ti.1:9]], [[1Pe.4.18|1Pe.4:18]]; p1., [[Mat.9.10-13; 11.19; 26.45|Mat.9:10-13 11:19 26:45]], al. (see MM, _VGT_, see word; Cremer, 102, 634)
(AS)

G0297.def:
**ἀμφότεροι**, -αι, -α
(replaces ἄμφω in κοινή, V. M, _Pr._, 57; used of more than two, _Pr._, 80; MM, _VGT_, see word), both of two: [[Mat.9.17|Mat.9:17]], al.
(AS)

G0256.def:
**Ἀλφαῖος** (WH, Ἀλ-), -ου, ὁ (Aram. חַלְפַּי)
Alphæus.
1. **Father of Levi**: [[Mrk.2.14|Mrk.2:14]]
2. **Father of James**: [[Mat.10.3|Mat.10:3]], [[Mrk.3.13|Mrk.3:13]], [[Luk.6.15|Luk.6:15]], [[Act.1.13|Act.1:13]].†
(AS)

G0260.def:
**ἅμα **
_adv._,
**at once **(Lat. simul): [[Act.24.26; 27.40|Act.24:26 27:40]], [[Rom.3.12|Rom.3:12]] (one and all = יַחַד, [[Psa.14.3|Psa.14:3]]), [[Col.4.3|Col.4:3]], [[1Ti.5.13|1Ti.5:13]], Phm 22; before σύν, [[1Th.4.17; 5.10|1Th.4:17 5:10]]; as prep. with dative, **together with**: [[Mat.13.29|Mat.13:29]] (see MM, _VGT_, see word); also, with adv., ἅ. πρωΐ (cl., ἅ. ἕω, etc.), **early in the morning**: [[Mat.20.1|Mat.20:1]]†
(AS)

G0224.def:
**ἄλευρον**, -ου, τό
(ἀλεύω, to grind), [in LXX for קֶמַח, [[Num.5.15|Num.5:15]], al. ;]
**real**: [[Mat.13.33|Mat.13:33]], [[Luk.13.21|Luk.13:21]].†
(AS)

G0245.def:
**ἀλλότριος**, -α, -ον
(ἄλλος), [in LXX for זוּר, נֵכָר, אַחֵר ;]
1. **be-longing to another, not one's own **(opposite to ἴδιος): [[Luk.16.12|Luk.16:12]], [[Rom.14.4; 15.20|Rom.14:4 15:20]] (Field, _Notes_, 165 f.), [[2Co.10.15-16|2Co.10:15-16]], [[1Ti.5.22|1Ti.5:22]], [[Heb.9.25|Heb.9:25]].
2. **foreign, strange, alien **(opposite to οἰκεῖος; see MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Mat.17.25-26|Mat.17:25-26]], [[Jhn.10.5|Jhn.10:5]], [[Act.7.6|Act.7:6]], [[Heb.11.9, 34|Heb.11:9, 34]].†
(AS)

G0290.def:
**ἀμπελών**, -ῶνος, ὁ
(ἄμπελος), [in LXX for כֶּרֶם ;]
**a vineyard**: [[Mat.20.1|Mat.20:1]] ff. [[Mat.21.28|Mat.21:28]] ff, [[Luk.13.6; 20.9|Luk.13:6 20:9]] ff., [[1Co.9.7|1Co.9:7]]. Æschin., 49, 13; Diod., al.; see MM, _VGT_, see word; LS, see word ἀμπελουργεῖον.)
(AS)

G0272.def:
**ἀμελέω**, -ῶ
(μέλει), [in LXX: [[Jer.4.17|Jer.4:17]] (מָרָה) [[Jer.31.32|Jer.31:32]] (בַּעַל), [[Wis.3.10|Wis.3:10]], [[2Ma.4.14|2Ma.4:14]] * ;]
(a) absol., **to be careless, not to care**: [[Mat.22.5|Mat.22:5]]
(b) with genitive, **to be careless of, to neglect**: [[1Ti.4.14|1Ti.4:14]], [[Heb.2.3; 8.9|Heb.2:3 8:9]] (see MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0227.def:
**ἀληθής**, -ές
(λήθω = λανθάνω, hence primarily, unconcealed, manifest; hence, actual, real), [in LXX for אֶמֶת, etc. ;]
(a) **of things, true, conforming to reality**: [[Jhn.4.18; 5.31-32; 6.55|Jhn.4:18 5:31-32 6:55]] (= ἀληθινός, which see) [[Jhn.8.13-14, 17; 10.41; 19.35; 21.24|Jhn.8:13-14, 17 10:41 19:35 21:24]], [[Act.12.9|Act.12:9]], [[Php.4.8|Php.4:8]], [[Tit.1.13|Tit.1:13]], [[1Pe.5.12|1Pe.5:12]], [[2Pe.2.22|2Pe.2:22]], [[1Jn.2.6|1Jn.2:6]], [[3Jn.12|3Jn.12]];
(b) **of persons, truthful**: [[Mat.22.16|Mat.22:16]], [[Mrk.12.14|Mrk.12:14]], [[Jhn.3.33; 7.18; 8.26|Jhn.3:33 7:18 8:26]], [[Rom.3.4|Rom.3:4]], [[2Co.6.8|2Co.6:8]].†
_SYN._: ἀληθινός, real, genuine, ideal, as opposite to spurious or imperfect ἀληθής, true to fact, as opposite to false, lying, denotes the actuality of a thing: ἀληθινός, its relation to the corresponding con­ception. (Cf. Tr., _Syn._, § viii; Cremer, 84 f., 631 Abbott, _JV_, 234 f.; _DB_, iv, 818 f.; MM, _VGT_, s.vv.) (AS)

G0225.def:
**ἀλήθεια**, -ας, ἡ
(ἀληθής), [in LXX chiefly for אֱמֶת (on which, see Cremer, 627f.), אֱמוּנָה ;]
**truth** (see _DB_, iv, 818f.).
1. **Objectively, "the reality lying at the basis of an appearance; the manifested, veritable essence of a matter" **(Cremer, 86): [[Rom.9.1|Rom.9:1]], al.; of religious truth, [[Rom.1.25|Rom.1:25]], al.; esp. of Christian doctrine, [[Gal.2.5|Gal.2:5]], al.; ἀ. θεοῦ, [[Rom.15.8|Rom.15:8]]
2. Subjectively, **truthfulness, truth**, not merely verbal (cl.), but sincerity and integrity of character: [[Jhn.8.44|Jhn.8:44]], [[3Jn.3|3Jo.3]].
3. **In phrases **(MM, _VGT_, see word): ἐπ᾽ ἀληθείας, [[Mrk.12.14|Mrk.12:14]], al.; ἀ. λέγειν (εἰπεῖν, λαλεῖν), [[Rom.9.1|Rom.9:1]], [[2Co.12.6|2Co.12:6]], [[Eph.4.25|Eph.4:25]], al.; ἀ. ποιεῖν, [[Jhn.3.21|Jhn.3:21]], [[1Jn.1.6|1Jn.1:6]] (cf. _DB_, iv, 818b, ff.).
(AS)

G0240.def:
**ἀλλήλων** (genitive pl.), dative -οις, -αις, accusative -ους, -ας, -α (no nom.), recipr. pron.
(ἄλλος),
**of one another, mutually**: [[Mat.25.32|Mat.25:32]], [[Mrk.4.41|Mrk.4:41]], [[Jhn.13.22|Jhn.13:22]], al.
(AS)

G0206.def:
**ἄκρος**, -α, -ον
[in LXX for קֶצַח, בֹּהֶן, etc. ;]
**highest**, **extreme**; as subst., τὸ ἄ., **the top**, **extremity**: [[Mrk.13.27|Mrk.13:27]], [[Luk.16.24|Luk.16:24]], [[Heb.11.21|Heb.11:21]]; pl. (cf. MM, _VGT_, see word), [[Mat.24.31|Mat.24:31]]†
(AS)

G0229.def:
**ἀλήθω**
(κοινή form of the Attic ἀλέω), [in LXX for טָחַן ;]
**to grind**: [[Mat.24.41|Mat.24:41]], [[Luk.17.35|Luk.17:35]].†
(AS)

G0211.def:
**ἀλάβαστρον**, -ου, τό (also -ος, ὁ, ἡ; colloq. and κοινή for ἀλάβαστος),
[in LXX: [[2Ki.21.13|4Ki.21:13]] (צַלַּחַת)* ;]
a** box of alabaster** (ἀλαβαστίτης) for ointment: [[Mat.26.7|Mat.26:7]], [[Mrk.14.3|Mrk.14:3]], [[Luk.7.37|Luk.7:37]] (see _DCG_, i, 41b; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0288.def:
**ἄμπελος**, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX for גֶּפֶן ;]
**vine**: [[Mat.26.29|Mat.26:29]], [[Mrk.14.25|Mrk.14:25]], [[Luk.22.18|Luk.22:18]] [[Jas.3.12|Jas.3:12]]; figuratively, of Christ, [[Jhn.15.1, 4-5|Jhn.15:1, 4-5]]; of his enemies (on the usage here, see MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Rev.14.18-19|Rev.14:18-19]]†
(AS)

G0275.def:
**ἀμέριμνος**, -ον
(μέριμνα), [in LXX: [[Wis.6.15; 7.23|Wis.6:15 7:23]] * ;]
**free from anxiety or care**: [[Mat.28.14|Mat.28:14]], [[1Co.7.32|1Co.7:32]] (for exx., see MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0237.def:
**ἀλλαχόθεν **
_adv._ (ἀλλος), [in LXX: [[4Ma.1.7|4Ma.1:7]] * ;] = ἀλλοθεν (seeMM, _VGT_, see word)
**from another place**: [[Jhn.10.1|Jhn.10:1]]†
(AS)

G0265.def:
**ἁμάρτημα**, -τος, τό
(ἁμαρτεῖν, see supr.), [in LXX for חַטָּאָה, עָוֺן etc. ;]
an act of disobedience to divine law (Lft., _Notes_, 273), **a sinful deed, a sin**: [[Mrk.3.28-29|Mrk.3:28-29]], [[Rom.3.25|Rom.3:25]], [[1Co.6.18|1Co.6:18]], [[2Pe.1.9|2Pe.1:9]], WH, mg.; αἰώνιωv ἀ. (_DCG_, i, 788a), [[Mrk.3.29|Mrk.3:29]] (for exx. from π., see MM, _VGT_, see word).†
_SYN._: ἀγνόημα, ἁμαρτία, ἀνομία, ἀσέβεια, ἥττημα, παράβασις, παρακοή, παρανομία, παράπτωμα (ν. Cremer, 100; Tr., _Syn._, § lxvi; _DB_, iv, 532; _DCG_, l.with; Westc, _Eph._, 165 f.) (AS)

G0214.def:
**ἀλαλάζω**
(onomat. from the battle-cry ἀλαλά), [in LXX chiefly for רוּעַ hi., יָלַל ;]
**prop, to raise a war-cry, shout with triumph or joy; rarely of grief, to wail**: [[Mrk.5.38|Mrk.5:38]] (cf. [[Jer.4.8|Jer.4:8]]); of a cymbal, ἀλαλάζον (RV. clanging), [[1Co.13.1|1Co.13:1]] (cf. ὀλολύζω).†
(AS)

G0296.def:
**ἄμφοδον**, -ου, το
(ἀμφί ὁδός), [in LXX for אַרְמוֹן ([[Jer.17.27; 30.10; 49.27|Jer.17:27 30:10 49:27]])* ;]
prop., **a road around anything **(RV, the open street): [[Mrk.11.4|Mrk.11:4]], [[Act.19.28|Act.19:28]], WH, mg.†
(AS)

G0219.def:
**ἀλεκτοροφωνία**, -ας, ἡ
(ἀλέκτωρ, φωνή),
cock-crowing, i.e. the third watch in the night: [[Mrk.13.35|Mrk.13:35]]†
(AS)

G0223.def:
**Ἀλέξανδρος**, -ου, ὁ,
**Alexander**
1. **Son of Simon of Cyrene**: [[Mrk.15.21|Mrk.15:21]]
2. **A kinsman of the High Priest**: [[Act.4.6|Act.4:6]]

† (AS)

G0273.def:
**ἄ-μεμπτος**, -ον
(μέμφομσι), [in LXX chiefly for תָּם ;]
blameless, free from fault (in π. of a marriage-contract; M, _Th._, I, 3:13; cf. MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Luk.1.6|Luk.1:6]], [[Php.2.15; 3.6|Php.2:15 3:6]], [[1Th.3.13|1Th.3:13]] (WH, mg., -ως) [[Heb.8.7|Heb.8:7]]†
_SYN._: ἄμωμος, ἀνέγκλητος, ἀνεπίλημπτος, which see (Tr., _Syn._, § ciii) (AS)

G0289.def:
**ἀμπελουργός**, -οῦ, ὁ, ἡ
[in LXX for כֹּרֵם ;]
**a vine dresser**: [[Luk.13.7|Luk.13:7]]†
(AS)

G0241.def:
**ἀλλογενής**, -ές
(ἄλλος, γένος), [in LXX chiefly for זוּר, נֵכָר ;]
**of another race, a foreigner **( = ἀλλόφυλος; Cremer, 150; MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Luk.17.18|Luk.17:18]]†
(AS)

G0286.def:
**ἀμνός**, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for כֶּבֶשׂ ;]
**a lamb**: figuratively, of Christ (_DCG_, ii, 620b), [[Jhn.1.29, 36|Jhn.1:29, 36]], [[Act.8.32|Act.8:32]]" (LXX), [[1Pe.1.19|1Pe.1:19]] (cf. ἀρνίον; Cremer, 102, 635).†
(AS)

G0242.def:
**ἅλλομαι **
[in LXX for צָלַח, דָּלַג pi., etc. ;]
**to leap**: [[Act.3.8; 14.10|Act.3:8 14:10]]; of water, to spring up, [[Jhn.4.14|Jhn.4:14]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0250.def:
**ἀλόη**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Sng.4.14|Sng.4:14]] א (אֲהָלִים)* ;]
**the aloe, aloes **(the powder of a fragrant wood): [[Jhn.19.39|Jhn.19:39]]†
(AS)

G0236.def:
**ἀλλάσσω**
(ἄλλος), [in LXX chiefly for חָלַף, מוּר hi., etc. ;]
1. **to change**: [[Act.6.14|Act.6:14]], [[Gal.4.20|Gal.4:20]].
2. **to transform**: [[1Co.15.51-52|1Co.15:51-52]], [[Heb.1.12|Heb.1:12]].
3. **to exchange**: with accusative, before ἐν (= בְּ, [[Psa.106.20|Psa.106:20]]) instead of simple genitive (Bl., § 36, 8), [[Rom.1.23|Rom.1:23]]
(cf. ἀπ-, δι-, κατ-, ἀπο-κατ-, μετ-, συν-αλλάσσω; see MM, _VGT_, see word).† (AS)

G0292.def:
**ἀμύνω **
[in LXX (mid.): [[Jos.10.13|Jos.10:13]] (נָקַם), נָקַם), [[Psa.118.10-12|Psa.118:10-12]] מוּל hi.), [[Isa.59.16|Isa.59:16]] (יָשַׁע hi.), [[Wis.11.3|Wis.11:3]], al. ;]
to ward off, etc. Mid.
(a) **to defend oneself against**;
(b) **to requite**;
(with) = act., **to defend, assist **(Isa, l.with): with accusative of person(s), [[Act.7.24|Act.7:24]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0246.def:
**ἀλλόφυλος**, -ον
(ἄλλος, φῦλον, a tribe), [in LXX chiefly for פְּלֶשֶׁת ;]
foreign, **of another race** (MM, _VGT_, see word); as opposite to a Jew, **a Gentile**: [[Act.10.28|Act.10:28]]†
(AS)

G0203.def:
**ἀκροβυστία**, -ας, ή
(perh. an Alexandrian form of cl. ἀκροποσθία; cf. MM, _VGT_, see word) [in LXX for עׇרְלָה ;]
**the prepuce**, **foreskin** (LXX), hence abstr., **uncircumcision**: [[Act.11.3|Act.11:3]], [[Rom.2.25-27; 3.30; 4.10-12|Rom.2:25-27 3:30 4:10-12]], [[1Co.7.18-19|1Co.7:18-19]], [[Gal.5.6; 6.15|Gal.5:6 6:15]], [[Col.2.13; 3.11|Col.2:13 3:11]] By meton., **the uncircumcised**: [[Rom.4.9|Rom.4:9]], [[Gal.2.7|Gal.2:7]], [[Eph.2.11|Eph.2:11]].†
(AS)

G0295.def:
**Ἀμφίπολις**, -εως, ἡ
**Amphipolis, in Macedonia, so called because the river Strymon flowed around it**: [[Act.17.1|Act.17:1]]†
(AS)

G0209.def:
**ἀκωλύτως **
_adv._ (κωλύω), [in Sm.: [[Job.34.31|Job.34:31]] * ;]
**without hindrance** (so frequently in legal documents; MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Act.28.31|Act.28:31]]†
(AS)

G0213.def:
**ἀλαζών**, -όνος, ὁ, ἡ
(ἄλη, **wandering**) [in LXX: [[Job.28.8|Job.28:8]] (שַׁחַץ) [[Hab.2.5|Hab.2:5]] (יָהִיר), [[Pro.21.24|Pro.21:24]] (לוּץ)* ;]
prop, **a vagabond**, hence, **an impostor**, **a boaster**: [[Rom.1.30|Rom.1:30]], [[2Ti.3.2|2Ti.3:2]].†
_SYN._: ὐβριστής, ὑπερήφανος (see Tr., _Syn._, § xxix; Lft., _Notes_, 256) (AS)

G0279.def:
**ἀμετανόητος**, -ον
(μετανοέω)
1. **impenitent**: [[Rom.2.5|Rom.2:5]]
2. = ἀμεταμέλητος (π., Philo, al.; see Deiss., BS, 257; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0248.def:
**ἀλοάω**, -ῶ
(ἅλως, see: ἅλων; and cf. MM, _VGT_, see word), [in LXX chiefly for דּוּשׁ ;]
**to thresh**: [[1Co.9.9; 9.13|1Co.9:9 9:13]]; [[1Ti.5.18|1Ti.5:18]].†
(AS)

G0210.def:
**ἀκων** (Attic contr. for ἀέκων), -ουα, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ἅκων, **willing**), [in LXX: [[Job.14.17|Job.14:17]], [[2Ma.11.12|2Ma.11:12]] * ;]
**unwilling**: [[1Co.9.17|1Co.9:17]]†
(AS)

G0280.def:
**ἄμετρος**, -ον
(μέτρον),
**without measure**: adverbially, εἰς τὰ ἄ., excessively, [[2Co.10.13; 10.15|2Co.10:13 10:15]]†
(AS)

G0299.def:
**ἄ-μωμος**, -ον
(μῶμος, which see), [in LXX chiefly for תָּמִים ];
**of sacrificial victims, without blemish**: of Christ, [[Heb.9.14|Heb.9:14]], [[1Pe.1.19|1Pe.1:19]]; etbically, **unblemished, faultless**: [[Eph.1.4; 5.27|Eph.1:4 5:27]], [[Php.2.15|Php.2:15]], [[Col.1.22|Col.1:22]], [[Jude.24|Ju 24]], [[Rev.14.5|Rev.14:5]] (Cremer, 425, 788; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
_SYN._: ἀμίαντος, ἄσπιλος (AS)

G0204.def:
**ἀκρο-γωνιαῖος**, -αία, -αῖον
(ἄκροι, γωνία, **an angle**) [in LXX: [[Isa.28.16|Isa.28:16]] (פִּנָּה) * ;] = Attic γωνιαῖος (frequently in Inscr.; MM, _VGT_, see word ἀ.),
**at the extreme angle**: ὁ ἀ., **the corner foundation stone**, [[Eph.2.20|Eph.2:20]], [[1Pe.2.6|1Pe.2:6]].†
(AS)

G0274.def:
**ἀ-μέμπτως**,
_ adv._ (ἄμεμπτος), [in LXX: [[Est.3.13|Est.3:13]] * ;]
**blamelessly **(Lft., _Notes_, 28, 89; MM, _VGT_, see word -ος): [[1Th.2.10; 3.13|1Th.2:10 3:13]] WH mg., 5:23.†
(AS)

G0269.def:
**ἄμαχος**, -ον
(μάχη);
1. invincible (frequently in cl.).
2. abstaining from fighting, non-combatant (Xen.). Metaphorical (cf. MM, _VGT_, see word), **not contentious**: [[1Ti.3.3|1Ti.3:3]], [[Tit.3.2|Tit.3:2]].†
(AS)

G0287.def:
**ἀμοιβή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀμείβομαι, to repay); [in Aq., Sm.: [[Pro.12.14|Pro.12:14]], al. ;]
**requital, recompense**: [[1Ti.5.4|1Ti.5:4]] (for illustration from τ.. see MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0276.def:
**ἀ-μετάθετος**, -ον
(μετατίθημι), [in LXX: [[3Ma.5.1|3Ma.5:1]] [[3Mac.5.12 |3Mac 5:12 ]]* ;]
**immutable**: [[Heb.6.18|Heb.6:18]] as subat., τὸ ἀ., immutability, [[Heb.6.17|Heb.6:17]] (see MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0282.def:
**ἀμήτωρ**, -ορος, ὁ, ἡ
(μήτηρ), **without a mother **(frequently in Gk. writers of the gods): ἀπάτωρ ἀ.
of one without recorded genealogy, [[Heb.7.3|Heb.7:3]] (cf. MM, _VGT_, see word)
(AS)

G0205.def:
**ἀκροθίνιον**, -ου, τό
(ἄκρος, θίς, **a heap**),
prop., **the top of a heap**, hence, in pl.,
1. **first-fruits** (Xen.; MM, _VGT_, see word).
2. In war, **the choicest spoils** (cf. Hdt., viii, 121 f.): [[Heb.7.4|Heb.7:4]]
† (AS)

G0283.def:
**ἀ-μίαντος**, -ον
(μιαίνω), [in LXX: [[Wis.3.13; 4.2; 8.20|Wis.3:13 4:2 8:20]], [[2Ma.14.36|2Ma.14:36]] [[2Mac.15.34 |2Mac 15:34 ]]* ;]
**undefiled, free from contamination **(in π., of αἰθήρ; MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Heb.7.26; 13.4|Heb.7:26 13:4]], [[1Pe.1.4|1Pe.1:4]], [[Jas.1.27|Jas.1:27]].†
_SYN._: ἄμωμος, ἄσπιλος (Cremer, 784) (AS)

G0212.def:
**ἀλαζονία**(Rec. -εία, the earlier form), -ας, ἡ
(ἀλαζών), [in LXX: [[Wis.5.8; 17.7, 2|Wis.5:8 17:7, 2]]; [[4Ma.5.1-38|4Ma.5:1-38]] * ;]
the character of an ἀλαζών, **boastfulness, vainglory, vaunting**: [[Jas.4.16|Jas.4:16]] (Mayor, in l), [[1Jn.2.16|1Jn.2:16]]†
(AS)

G0263.def:
**ἀμάραντος**, -ον
(μαραίνομαι), [in LXX: [[Wis.6.12|Wis.6:12]] (σοφία)* ;]
**un­fading **(whence ὁ ἀ., the amaranth, an unfading flower): [[1Pe.1.4|1Pe.1:4]] (cf. MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0244.def:
**ἀλλοτρι-επίσκοπος** (Rec. ἀλλοτριοεπ-), -ου, ὁ
**one who meddles in things alien to his calling**: [[1Pe.4.15|1Pe.4:15]] (see _ICC_, in l; Deiss., BS, 224-4; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0261.def:
**ἀμαθής**, -ές
(μανθάνω), [in Sm.: [[Psa.49.11|Psa.49:11]] * ;]
**unlearned, ignorant**: [[2Pe.3.16|2Pe.3:16]] (on the rareness of this word, see MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0239.def:
**ἁλληλουιά**
(Rec. ἀλληλούϊα; _Heb._ הָלַל יָהּ, praise the Lord), [in LXX in the titles of certain Psa (104 (105), al.), and at the end of [[Psa.150.1-6;|Psa.150:1-6]] also [[Tob.13.18|Tob.13:18]], [[3Ma.7.13|3Ma.7:13]] ;]
**hallelujah, alleluia**: [[Rev.19.1, 3-4; 19.6|Rev.19:1, 3-4 19:6]].†
(AS)

G0271.def:
**ἀμέθυστος**, -ου, ἡ
(accusative to Plut., ἀ- μεθύω, being regarded as an antidote against drunkenness) [in LXX: [[Exo.28.19; 36.19; 39.12|Exo.28:19 36:19 39:12]] [[Ezk.28.13|Eze.28:13]] * ;]
**amethyst, a purple quartz**: [[Rev.21.20|Rev.21:20]]†
(AS)
